title: Produce Traceability Maintenance Checklist Form
subtitle: Produce Traceability route the work, prepare controls, record tasks and parts, test the result, manage unresolved conditions, and authorize return to use.
description: An original, workflow-complete produce traceability maintenance checklist covering identity and routing, domain observations and evidence, accountable decisions, exceptions and escalation, and completion handoff without replacing qualified judgment.
use_case: Use for scheduled or corrective maintenance that needs task evidence, measurements, parts traceability, function checks, restrictions, and handoff. The record is owned by the produce traceability owner and closes only after evidence, exceptions, disposition, and the next accountable handoff are documented.

sections.title: Produce Traceability maintenance routing
sections.guidance: Identify the work, subject, assigned person, and review owner.

blocks.label: Maintenance Checklist identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Assign one owner and use the same record ID in attachments and follow-up.

blocks.label: Produce Lot Or Tracking Event identity
blocks.guidance: Preserve the identifiers used by the controlling farm, facility, or partner record.

sections.title: Produce Traceability work preparation
sections.guidance: Record instructions, condition, controls, and parts before work.

blocks.label: Pre-work review and controls
items: Produce description, variety, quantity, and unit were recorded
Traceability lot code and code-source location were captured
Tracking event type, date, time, and location were captured
Immediate previous source or next recipient was identified
Reference document type and number were linked
Transformation, repacking, or commingling links were preserved
Corrections retain the original record and responsible person
Held, recalled, or unreconciled lots remain visible

sections.title: Produce Traceability maintenance tasks
sections.guidance: Record completed tasks separately from measurements and findings.

blocks.label: Produce Traceability task checklist
items: Traceability plan and responsible contacts are current
Location identifiers and master data are reconciled
Lot-code format, source, and assignment controls were tested
Printers, labels, scanners, and readers were function-checked
Receiving, packing, transformation, and shipping interfaces were tested
Reference documents link to event records
Corrections preserve history and responsible user
Access, backup, export, and retrieval controls were tested
Exception queue and held-lot visibility were reviewed
Mock trace and reconciliation results were documented

sections.title: Produce Traceability parts and service evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve material, service, and removed-part traceability.

blocks.label: Work performed, deviations from plan, and supporting references

sections.title: Produce Traceability function test and decision
sections.guidance: Separate the test evidence from return-to-use authorization.

blocks.label: Function and handback evidence
items: Produce Traceability before-and-after results support the recorded status
Tasks, measurements, parts, and outside service are documented
Function testing is separate from return-to-use authorization
Restrictions and unfinished work have owners and due points
Qualified review was obtained where work or disposition exceeds authority

sections.title: Produce Traceability unresolved conditions
sections.guidance: Preserve restrictions and route decisions beyond the maintainer’s authority.

blocks.label: Maintenance authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This original worksheet supports trace investigation but does not determine regulatory coverage or authorize a hold, release, or recall. A qualified owner must apply the current traceability plan and applicable requirements, preserve record history, and escalate any gap affecting lot identity or disposition.

blocks.label: Produce Traceability unresolved-condition triggers
items: Lot code, code source, or product identity is missing
Quantity, unit, split, or transformation does not reconcile
Event date, location, source, or recipient is missing
Reference document or system link cannot be retrieved
Label, case, pallet, invoice, or shipment mismatch
Held, recalled, corrected, or commingled lot remains unresolved

blocks.label: Restriction, immediate action, owner, due point, and final disposition

sections.title: Produce Traceability maintenance closeout
sections.guidance: Transfer restrictions, next service, and evidence to operations.

blocks.label: Produce Traceability open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Produce Traceability handoff confirmations
items: Work, measurements, parts, and removed material were reconciled
Restrictions and unfinished work were transferred to operations
Next maintenance, inspection, or verification point was assigned
Produce Traceability return-to-use handback was acknowledged
Work records, manuals, photos, and service evidence were filed
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.

blocks.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes
